text: Debugging is an essential skill for every programmer. When something goes wrong in your code, the first step is identifying bugs by carefully reading error messages and understanding what the program was supposed to do. Many debugging tools, such as breakpoints and step-by-step execution, help you observe how your code actually behaves. A systematic approach is important: change one thing at a time and test your fix before moving on. Logging is another powerful technique, because well-placed log statements record what happens while the program runs, making it easier to find the source of a problem. With patience and practice, anyone can become a confident debugger.
